core_obligations: Realize a quasi-compact open V of |Y| as |Y'| for an open subspace Y' and note that Y' is quasi-compact (proof lines 1274-1279).
Use quasi-compactness of f to conclude that X' = Y' x_Y X is a quasi-compact algebraic space (proof lines 1279-1280).
Identify X' with an open subspace of X and its underlying set with |f|^{-1}(V) (proof lines 1281-1284).
Conclude that |f|^{-1}(V) is a quasi-compact open of |X|, i.e. that |f| is quasi-compact (proof lines 1285-1287).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: if f : X -> Y is a quasi-compact morphism of algebraic spaces over S, then the underlying map of topological spaces |f| : |X| -> |Y| is quasi-compact, i.e. the preimage of every quasi-compact open is quasi-compact (source lines 1266-1271). The proof realizes a quasi-compact open V of |Y| as the underlying set of an open subspace Y', uses that Y' is then a quasi-compact algebraic space, so that X' = Y' x_Y X is quasi-compact by the definition of quasi-compactness of f, identifies |X'| with |f|^{-1}(V) via the description of the points of the fibre product, and concludes that this preimage is a quasi-compact open of |X|.
